headline: 17-year wait ends: Mohammedan wins DPL crown after dramatic finale
summary: The traditional giants secure their first Dhaka Premier League title since 2008-09, ending a long drought in a rain-affected final day.
details: Mohammedan Sporting Club have been crowned Dhaka Premier League (DPL) champions for the first time in 17 years. The victory was secured under dramatic circumstances at BKSP-3 on Friday.

Entering their final match against Abahani, Mohammedan needed a win and a favor from Dhaka Leopards to beat Prime Bank Cricket Club. They did their part by posting a commanding 406 for four, with Parvez Emon scoring 150 and Anamul Haque Bijoy scoring 141.
Rain played a critical role in the final outcome. The match against Abahani was abandoned at 5:35 pm with Abahani at 178 for four, resulting in a 63-run victory for Mohammedan via the DLS method.
Simultaneously, at BKSP-4, the Dhaka Leopards secured a nine-run DLS win over Prime Bank. This result triggered celebrations in the Mohammedan camp as it handed them the title.
Mohammedan finished the tournament with 18 points, while Abahani and Prime Bank both finished on 16. Abahani took the runners-up spot due to a superior head-to-head record.
This marks Mohammedan's first DPL title since 2008-09 and their first since the competition attained List A status. The club had won the Premier League nine times before that transition.
caption:
A 17-year wait is finally over! Mohammedan Sporting Club are the champions of the Dhaka Premier League.

Mohammedan Sporting Club have been crowned Dhaka Premier League (DPL) champions for the first time in 17 years. The victory was secured under dramatic circumstances at BKSP-3 on Friday.

Entering their final match against Abahani, Mohammedan needed a win and a favor from Dhaka Leopards to beat Prime Bank Cricket Club. They did their part by posting a commanding 406 for four, with Parvez Emon scoring 150 and Anamul Haque Bijoy scoring 141.

Rain played a critical role in the final outcome. The match against Abahani was abandoned at 5:35 pm with Abahani at 178 for four, resulting in a 63-run victory for Mohammedan via the DLS method.

Simultaneously, at BKSP-4, the Dhaka Leopards secured a nine-run DLS win over Prime Bank. This result triggered celebrations in the Mohammedan camp as it handed them the title.

Mohammedan finished the tournament with 18 points, while Abahani and Prime Bank both finished on 16. Abahani took the runners-up spot due to a superior head-to-head record.

This marks Mohammedan's first DPL title since 2008-09 and their first since the competition attained List A status. The club had won the Premier League nine times before that transition.

headline_marked: Afran Nisho returns as Masud in [[‘Surongo 2’ officially announced]]
headline: Afran Nisho returns as Masud in ‘Surongo 2’ officially announced
summary: Filmmaker Raihan Rafi reunites with Afran Nisho for a sequel to the 2023 blockbuster, promising a bigger and more thrilling chapter.
details: Filmmaker Raihan Rafi has officially announced the production of “Surongo 2”, confirming that Afran Nisho will return as the popular character Masud.
The announcement was made via a Facebook post, sparking excitement among fans of the 2023 hit film.
The sequel is being produced by SVF Alpha-i Entertainment and is described as a major expansion of the Raihan Film Universe.
Raihan Rafi promised that the new chapter will be “bigger, bolder and more thrilling” than the original movie.
The first Surongo movie marked Afran Nisho’s big-screen debut and was both a commercial and critical success.
Following widespread acclaim for Nisho's performance as Masud, there had been significant speculation about a sequel.
“Surongo 2” is slated for release in cinemas in December 2026.
caption:
Masud is back! Afran Nisho and Raihan Rafi reunite for the highly anticipated sequel 'Surongo 2'.

Filmmaker Raihan Rafi has officially announced the production of “Surongo 2”, confirming that Afran Nisho will return as the popular character Masud.

The announcement was made via a Facebook post, sparking excitement among fans of the 2023 hit film.

The sequel is being produced by SVF Alpha-i Entertainment and is described as a major expansion of the Raihan Film Universe.

Raihan Rafi promised that the new chapter will be “bigger, bolder and more thrilling” than the original movie.

The first Surongo movie marked Afran Nisho’s big-screen debut and was both a commercial and critical success.

Following widespread acclaim for Nisho's performance as Masud, there had been significant speculation about a sequel.

“Surongo 2” is slated for release in cinemas in December 2026.
